correctness.rationale: The projector equals the spectral positive part, giving three explicit spectral-sign regions. In the indefinite region, exact coordinate derivatives yield diagonal absolute row maximum 3/2 and off-diagonal absolute row maximum 9/8. Scalar parameter bounds are complete for every spectral orientation; line-segment integration extends them globally, with determinant-zero lines handled separately. Two explicit rank-one perturbation limits establish sharpness, and strict interior derivative bounds imply no distinct finite pair attains either value. A 407-assertion standard-library exact-rational and high-precision checker confirms formulas and examples without replacing the analytic proof.

value.rationale: For the smallest genuinely matrix-valued PSD spectral repair problem, the result gives a complete and nontrivial distinction between diagonal 50% amplification and off-diagonal 12.5% amplification under entrywise bounded input noise. It also explains why the worst case occurs only infinitesimally at two different rank-one boundary geometries. This sharp robustness threshold is not implied by ordinary Frobenius nonexpansivity, and the diagonal obstruction embeds into every larger matrix order; no claim of a general high-dimensional theorem is needed.
